name: laptop-integrated-8gb
deviceClass: Windows laptop, Intel Iris Xe integrated GPU, 8 GB RAM
source: Core i5-1135G7 class (4 cores, 8 threads, Iris Xe 80 EU), 14 inch 1920x1080 at 125 percent Windows scaling (1536x864 CSS px). Chrome reports deviceMemory in powers of two capped at 8, so an 8 GB laptop is assumed to report 8 (some 8 GB machines may report 4; not measured). GPU limits are the WebGPU specification default limits (the floor every adapter must meet), not a measurement of this device. What an Iris Xe laptop really reports for maxBufferSize was not measured: the measured NVIDIA card reports 2 GiB, so a real Iris Xe may report more than this. User agent follows the shape current Chrome sends (reduced UA); the version number is illustrative.
userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/140.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
